results.title: Inventory oversell during flash sale
results.query: We have negative stock numbers on our top-selling items after the holiday promo. Multiple buyers bought the zero-inventory items concurrently.

results.title: Payment webhook silently failing
results.query: Stripe shows payments as succeeded, but orders are stuck in pending state and not moving to processing due to webhook verification warnings.

results.title: Tax calculation API timeout
results.query: Checkout hangs and eventually fails for customers when computing state sales tax. Looking like a 15-second socket timeout on the tax partner endpoint.

results.title: Loyalty points not deducting on purchase
results.query: Buyers are redeeming reward points at checkout, but their rewards balance is not getting debited after the order is placed.

results.title: Database deadlock on order fulfillment
results.query: Warehouse workers cannot update order status to shipped. Postgres logs show deadlock detected and ShareLock conflicts between processes.

results.title: Incorrect currency conversion at checkout
results.query: European shoppers are being undercharged. The EUR/USD FX rate looks stale in our Redis cache because rates haven't refreshed in 48 hours.

results.title: PDF invoice generation memory leak
results.query: Node.js application worker OOM crashing every few hours under heavy traffic. Heap allocation keeps growing when rendering invoice PDFs with Puppeteer.

results.title: Session hijacking via predictable JWT tokens
results.query: Pen-test report warns that authorization tokens use weak signing and can be spoofed, resulting in concurrent logins from different IP addresses on a single session.

results.title: Apple Pay token decryption failure
results.query: iPhone users cannot finish purchase via Apple Pay. The payment token decryption crashes with invalid PKCS7 padding error on the certificate.

results.title: Promo code stacking logic error
results.query: Shoppers are combining multiple discount coupons that should not be stackable, causing cart balances to drop below zero.

results.title: ElasticSearch catalog out of sync
results.query: Disabled and out-of-catalog items are still visible in store search results because bulk reindexing failed on a price field float parsing error.

results.title: Duplicate refund processing
results.query: Support agents double-clicking the refund button in the CRM issues two payout transactions to the customer for the same charge.

results.title: Redis cache stampede on homepage products
results.query: Relational DB hits 100% utilization at the top of every hour because all featured products cache keys expire at the exact same second.

results.title: Gift card double spend race condition
results.query: A buyer redeemed the same voucher balance twice across two simultaneous checkout tabs without deducting balance between them.

results.title: Refunds to expired cards fail silently
results.query: When refunding an order to a credit card that passed its expiration date, Stripe returns expired_card decline, and the refund gets stuck in limbo without notifying support.
